title: hierarchy/reader/<school>.jsonl.gz
description: The reader export: one row per lab paper with a confirmed full-text copy, saying whether the site hosts the copy (licence allows redistribution) or links to the source. Readable = host or link.
x-readers: the site builder (reader/ in a release)

key.description: Paper key (the lab-paper work id, else its OpenAlex id).

arxiv.description: arXiv id of the copy or the paper.

readable.description: Always true in this file: a paper with a confirmed copy is readable, hosted or linked.

decision.description: host = the site hosts our copy; link = the site links to the source (never hosted when stored_copy is false).

license.description: Normalised licence (cc-by, cc-by-sa, cc-by-nc, cc-by-nc-sa, cc-by-nd, cc-by-nc-nd, cc0, public-domain, arxiv-nonexclusive, other-oa, ...), null when unknown.

source_url.description: The open page to read at the source (arXiv abs page, repository landing page, publisher page or DOI).

sha256.description: sha256 of the stored file (null for a link from a candidate URL: there is no stored copy).

format.description: File format (null without a stored copy).

path.description: Store-relative path of the file (host rows only).

version.description: Version of the copy as the catalog records it (publishedVersion, acceptedVersion, submittedVersion).

identity_check.description: How the copy's identity was confirmed.

catalog_work.description: The store catalog work id of the copy.

lookup_keys.description: The keys the site looks the work up by.

link_basis.description: Why the link is to this paper: confirmed_copy (we hold a confirmed copy, not licensed for hosting), or for a candidate URL with no stored copy: arxiv_id_doi, openalex_location, arxiv_metadata, landing_page_metadata. Null for host rows.

stored_copy.description: We hold a confirmed copy of the file (always true for host rows; false for a link from a candidate URL).
